_port_note: The investor slot selects `expiring_sheet` (the live sheet with the fewest business days left), not the first investor by id: funding.sheet_days_left is a minimum across live sheets, so without the selector the card would name one investor beside another investor's deadline. The latch is entity-keyed, so each sheet gets its own card. The body is inline in both locales rather than a CSV key because {seam:} tokens cannot live in strings.csv: loc_csv_integrity counts braces against [a-z_]+ tokens and rejects them.
speaker: char_mentor_frank

tr.title: VC_EV_OFFER_EXPIRING_TITLE
tr.body:
{investor} teklifi masada.

Frank: "Yatırımcılar bekletilmeyi sevmez. {seam:funding.sheet_days_left} gün içinde yanıt vermeliyiz."

en.title: VC_EV_OFFER_EXPIRING_TITLE
en.body:
{investor}'s offer is on the table.

Frank: "Investors don't like being kept waiting. We need to give them an answer inside {seam:funding.sheet_days_left} days."
